description: The Sendai Framework indicators are the 38 indicators agreed to measure progress on the seven global targets of the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction 2015 to 2030. The PreventionWeb page read on 2026-09-28 lists them by target: deaths and missing persons, affected people, direct economic loss, damage to critical infrastructure and disruption of basic services, national and local risk reduction strategies, international cooperation, and early warning coverage. Target C includes direct economic loss from damaged or destroyed critical infrastructure, and target D counts damaged health and educational facilities, other infrastructure units and facilities, and disruptions to basic services, with Member States choosing which infrastructure elements to count and describing them in metadata. Coverage is global, reported by UN Member States against a 2005 to 2015 baseline. Access to the page is free; no licence is stated. Caveats: this record covers the indicator definitions; the reported country data sit in the Sendai Framework Monitor, which blocked the cloud session with a script check, and national definitions of critical infrastructure differ. It supports resilience and recovery studies, such as structuring an infrastructure damage and service disruption database so it lines up with national Sendai reporting. Related record: DesInventar Sendai holds national disaster loss databases.
